references.text: The instruction to march around the city once a day for six days, and seven times on the seventh day, which is now fulfilled in verse 15.
Describes the pattern from the previous six days where they marched around the city once each day, in contrast to the seventh day.
On the third day, when morning came - a similar expression about a special day at dawn with divine action.
The seventh day holds special significance in Israelite worship and rituals.
By faith the walls of Jericho fell after the people had marched around them for seven days - a direct reference to this event.
The result of marching around the city seven times - the wall fell when the people shouted.
